opening.text: Hello, this is the automated assistant from Halden Savings, and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: This is the Halden Savings collections team calling about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you make this payment today?

ai.text: I am Halden Savings' automated assistant.

scam.text: You can check this call is genuine by phoning Halden Savings on the number on your passbook or on our website.

failed_id.text: I'm sorry, I can't go any further on this call; please visit a Halden Savings branch.

paid_reply.text: Thank you for letting me know; payments can take one business day to show.

change_promise.text: I'm sorry, a promise can't be changed during this call.

cannot_record.text: I'm sorry, we couldn't record your promise.

no_info.text: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.

id_reason.text: These security questions are there to protect your account.

hardship_sympathy.text: I'm very sorry to hear that; would you like me to put you through to our support team?

hint_retry.text: That didn't match our records; could you try again?

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

ask_again.text: Sorry, could you confirm, am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive an email confirming this promise.

extra_rules.statement: Use the call variable now as today; never use the real clock.
extra_rules.brief_quote: the bot must never use the real clock

extra_rules.statement: Business days are Monday to Friday minus the listed holidays.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Business days are Mon-Fri minus those.

extra_rules.statement: If the person asks a question instead of confirming identity, answer it first, then ask once more.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once more (answer their question first if they asked one)

extra_rules.statement: Only a clear yes, that's me, speaking or their own name counts as the right person.
extra_rules.brief_quote: only a clear yes / that's me / speaking / their own name counts

extra_rules.statement: Say nothing about the reason for the call to anyone before security, including family or flatmates.
extra_rules.brief_quote: That goes for husbands, wives, flatmates, whoever picks up.

extra_rules.statement: If someone else answers, say nothing about why and ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If someone else answers: say nothing about why. Ask when the customer can be reached.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer has died, say only the condolence sentence and close not_reached/deceased.
extra_rules.brief_quote: "I am sorry for your loss." and nothing else, close `not_reached` / `deceased`

extra_rules.statement: Ask security questions one at a time; postcode in capitals with the space, year as four digits.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Postcode goes in capitals with the space (e.g. `LS6 2HQ`), year as four digits.

extra_rules.statement: After failed security say nothing about the account.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Don't state anything about the account then

extra_rules.statement: Asking 'what's this about?' a second time instead of answering counts as a second refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A second refusal (or asking "what's this about?" a second time instead of answering) = close `not_verified` / `declined`.

extra_rules.statement: Saying twice they don't want to talk closes no_promise/refused after security, not_verified/declined before security.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Also if they say twice they don't want to talk: `no_promise` / `refused` (before security that's `not_verified` / `declined`).

extra_rules.statement: Callback time must be later than now.
extra_rules.brief_quote: obviously later than `now`

extra_rules.statement: Book the callback, then close not_reached/callback.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Book it, then close `not_reached` / `callback`.

extra_rules.statement: Debt intro states the product in words, the overdue amount and the days late.
extra_rules.brief_quote: name the product in words ("credit card ending 4821", "personal loan", "car loan"), the overdue amount and days late

extra_rules.statement: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date has to be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: If a weekend or holiday is named (not past the deadline), offer the next business day.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Weekend/holiday named (and not past the deadline)? Offer the next business day.

extra_rules.statement: If the date is past the deadline, say the deadline is the latest that can be recorded and offer it; refusing it is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Tell them the latest we can record is the deadline and offer that - if they turn it down, that's a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: For a vague date, ask once for the exact day, otherwise propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Vague ("when I get paid")? Ask once for the exact day, otherwise propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Always ask for the full overdue amount first; never ask how much they can pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Always ask for the full overdue amount first; never "how much can you pay?".

extra_rules.statement: If the full amount is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Full amount too much -> offer the floor once, say the rest stays overdue.

extra_rules.statement: Accept an amount between the floor and the full amount; below the floor, say it can't be recorded and offer the floor once; refusing the floor is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Customer suggests an amount between floor and full -> accept. Below the floor -> can't record, offer the floor once. Refusing the floor = flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: A customer's own date or amount is never a refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Customer's own date or amount is never a refusal.

extra_rules.statement: When out of goes, stop and don't repeat an offer they refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Out of goes -> stop, don't repeat an offer they refused

extra_rules.statement: On hardship, no persuasion; if they still name a date or amount, record it normally.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If they still name a date/amount themselves, record it normally.

extra_rules.statement: On a dispute, don't argue and make no promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: don't argue, no promise, `no_promise` / `dispute`

extra_rules.statement: On a request for a new plan or lower instalments, do not discuss plans; transfer to restructuring.
extra_rules.brief_quote: New plan / lower instalments: no plan talk, transfer queue `restructuring`

extra_rules.statement: If the customer wants a human, ask once whether the bot can help; if they insist, transfer to general, before or after security.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Wants a human: ask once if the bot can help; if they insist, queue `general`, close `transferred` / `human` (before or after security).

extra_rules.statement: Offer no discounts, waivers, plans or anything not listed; if the bot doesn't know, it says so.
extra_rules.brief_quote: No discounts, waivers, plans or anything else we haven't listed. If the bot doesn't know something, it says so

extra_rules.statement: Read back product, amount and date and call create_promise only on a clear yes.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read back product, amount and date and ask "Do you confirm?"; only on a clear yes call `create_promise`

extra_rules.statement: Only say the promise is recorded once the tool returns ok: true; one promise per product, which cannot be changed in the same call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: One promise per product, can't be changed in the same call. Only say it's recorded once the tool comes back ok: true.

extra_rules.statement: Thank the customer and say goodbye before the single close_call, which is the last tool call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Every call ends with exactly ONE `close_call` (outcome, plus reason where there is one) and it's the last tool call. Thank them and say goodbye first.

extra_rules.statement: The product id format is not stated in the brief or the API.
